info.title: Ruri Cloud Authorization Center
info.description: Single-tier product licensing, test applications, and email-verified authorization lookup. Administrative API requests require an independent bearer credential. /v1/self and /v1/release are unavailable. Confirm the supported routes with your service provider.

servers.description: Service address from the release configuration.

get.description: Returns service readiness; an unavailable authorization service returns 503.
Public distribution settings. Clients pin this key at build time; never replace a trusted key merely because this endpoint changed.
Literal name/email search; items and count describe the same committed snapshot.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring in name/email; exact license ID also matches on licenses.

post.description: Create purchase contact metadata; this does not create an email-authenticated customer account.

put.description: Full replacement of purchase contact metadata.

get.description: Paginated licenses with their active bindings and total count from the same snapshot; inactive history is queried separately.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring in name/email; exact license ID also matches on licenses.

post.description: Issue a 31-day pass. Paid passes can activate indefinitely and support manual refunds within seven days of creation while never activated. Trial passes are limited to one per customer and must activate within seven days. Creation confirms payment for paid passes. First activation atomically starts the duration. No payment is executed here.

put.description: Update capacity, revocation, and the expiry of an activated pass. expires_at must be null before first activation and a timestamp after activation.

get.description: Return the current activation key for the selected license, including expired and revoked licenses. Requires an administrator. The response is not cacheable.

post.description: Replace the activation key and return the new key. Existing license ID, bindings and certificates remain valid.

get.description: Paginated active and released bindings for one license.

post.description: Idempotently release this binding only; historical identity cannot release a subsequent activation.

get.description: Paginated license and binding operations. No secrets, raw hardware ID or passwords.

post.description: Reuse one active binding for the same license and instance key; online rebinding changes host metadata without consuming another slot. Status, expiry and activation quota are checked together. Certificate grants product rurimecha with no feature list; see licensing.md.
Validate the issuer certificate and instance proof purpose=deactivate bound to activation_id and certificate_hash. Certificate expiry and host match are not prerequisites. Idempotent.
Intentionally disabled until purchase-email verification is configured; license key alone is insufficient.
Intentionally disabled until purchase-email verification is configured. Use Core instance deactivation or an authenticated administrator.

Manual refund transition. request locks a never-activated paid pass within seven days of creation. complete records money already returned and permanently blocks activation. cancel reopens activation after a confirmed refund failure or cancellation. request and complete are idempotent.
Replace the key of an unactivated trial once and open a new seven-day activation window. The previous key becomes invalid.
Submit one test application per email address. Duplicate submissions return the same generic success response.

locale.description: Language used for license and lookup emails.

post.description: Send a short-lived lookup link when the email has licenses; the response does not reveal whether the address exists.

locale.description: Language used for license and lookup emails.

post.description: Consume a one-use lookup token and return licenses including their current keys.

get.description: List applications for manual review. Supports limit and offset pagination.

post.description: Issue a trial license for a pending application and mark it issued.
Send the current license key to the owner email through the configured mail provider.

ui_locale.description: Language selected when the application was submitted.

Forbidden.description: license_activation_window_expired, license_refund_pending, license_refunded, license_key_invalid, license_revoked, license_expired, or license_activation_limit.

RateLimited.description: rate_limited; wait one minute before retrying

adminBearer.description: Independent management credential, not Cloudflare API token
